question: Identify the iron and steel plant that was developed in collaboration with Germany.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rourkela**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Rourkela Steel Plant (RSP) was set up in collaboration with Germany in the 1950s.
 
• It is located in Rourkela, Odisha, and is the first integrated steel plant in the public sector in India.
 
• RSP was established with the assistance of the German companies Krupp and Demag.
 
• The plant was inaugurated in 1959 and has been a significant contributor to India's steel production capacity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Iron and Steel Industry in India**

 
 
• India has a rich history of iron and steel production dating back to ancient times.
 
• The modern iron and steel industry in India began in the late 19th century with the establishment of Tata Iron and Steel Company (TISCO) in 1907.
 
• Post-independence, India developed several public sector steel plants, including those at Bhilai, Durgapur, Rourkela, and Bokaro.
 
• These plants were established with assistance from different countries – Bhilai with the USSR, Durgapur with the UK, and Rourkela with Germany.
 
 
 
• **Rourkela Steel Plant (RSP)**
 
 
• RSP is the first integrated steel plant in the public sector in India, established with assistance from the German companies Krupp and Demag.
 
• It was inaugurated in 1959 and has been a major producer of various steel products.
 
• The plant is known for its production of high-quality steel and has undergone several modernization programs to increase its capacity and efficiency.
 
• RSP has played a pivotal role in the industrialization and economic development of the region.
 
 
 
• **Collaboration with Germany**
 
 
• The collaboration with Germany for the establishment of Rourkela Steel Plant was part of India's efforts to leverage foreign expertise and technology for its industrial development.
 
• German companies Krupp and Demag provided the technological know-how and equipment for the plant.
 
• This collaboration marked a significant milestone in Indo-German industrial cooperation.
 
• The success of RSP paved the way for further collaborations and the development of more steel plants in India.
